rules.statement: An unwritten contract for the sale of goods, where an action lies on some other ground such as a breach of warranty, is governed by section 7 of the Prescription Ordinance rather than section 8.
rules.supporting_quote: "Macdonell C. J. took the view (at page 178) that in a case of sale of goods the present section 8 refers only to the unwritten contract for which an action lies owing to the fact of delivery of the goods and that where the action lies on some other ground as, for example, a breach of warranty in delivering goods not up to sample (as in that case) the present s.7 of the Ordinance is the governing section."
